topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the main themes, cellular histopathology connections, and expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery of tumor viruses and cell transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the discovery of transforming tumor viruses and the experimental assays used to demonstrate oncogene-driven cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the classification of cancer-associated mutations and demonstrate their molecular mechanisms using cell cycle regulators and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the underlying DNA repair failures and replication or mitotic errors that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the stepwise progression of cancer through acquired and inherited mutations and evaluate the necessity of genetic instability for malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks, offers reading recommendations, and outlines the subject of the next lecture.
